responsibility: Implements the RISC-V target’s substantial common option layer: it records ISA extension implication and version tables, participates in target option handling, computes multilib directory selection from parsed -march/-mabi and multilib condition sets, exposes valid -mcpu/-mtune values, and defines RISC-V optimization defaults such as section anchors, redundant extension removal, and optional async unwind tables. This is the shared policy and option-resolution file that bridges GCC’s driver/common framework with RISC-V ISA subset parsing and multilib selection.
